# Spiritual @ Stage 10 — Concrete Peak

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Expression on this line

Spiritual capacity at Order 9 is complex spiritual integration: the individual coordinates
multiple spiritual practices and traditions into a coherent whole — meditation practice
alongside social justice engagement, contemplative prayer alongside community service,
mystical experience alongside ethical commitment. The advance over Stage 9 is that spiritual
development is no longer just systematic but integrated: multiple spiritual dimensions are
held in productive tension within one coherent spiritual life.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt richness of a multi-dimensional spiritual life.
- **UR:** reliable integration of multiple spiritual practices and traditions.
- **LL:** a spiritual culture that values integration — communities that support multiple
  spiritual dimensions simultaneously.
- **LR:** the institutional structures that provide platforms for integrated spiritual practice.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** integration paralysis — holding so many spiritual dimensions that no
  coherent practice emerges.
- **Dark allergy:** integration failure — the individual cannot integrate multiple spiritual
  dimensions, remaining at one-dimensional practice.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved contemplative depth (Stage 11) while actually
  just integrating multiple practices.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with spiritual integration because it dilutes purity
  of tradition.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Multi-dimensional spiritual practice:** the individual integrates multiple spiritual
  practices into one coherent life.
- **Cross-traditional fluency:** the individual demonstrates competence across multiple
  spiritual traditions.
- **Integrated spiritual life:** multiple spiritual dimensions are held in productive tension.

## Sources, joints, open questions

Huxley, *The Perennial Philosophy* (spiritual integration across traditions).
**Open joints:** How does spiritual integration shade into contemplative depth (Stage 11)?
